turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me before my son's zero went up.
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Open mind? I came with a question. Who decided on the zero?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
I haven't ruled the principal out. Who decided on the zero?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
Friendly isn't something I agree to before I've seen anything. What do you actually have on Owen's essay?
